description: Return one rule page: slug, category, title, description, checklist, and the markdown body, which includes the page's HTML/CSS code. Accepts the full slug (e.g. "compatibility/responsive"), just the page name ("responsive"), or a page link from a body ("/email-playbook/compatibility/responsive/"). Get the slugs from list_categories. Much smaller than fetching the whole category with get_playbook_rules.

include_examples.description: Also return the code examples as a separate array (they are already in the body). Default false.

name: get_rule
